models.name: ReaderSyncProtocol

properties.name: TypeOK
properties.summary: All server tables, sequence counters, record versions, open conflicts, positions, and blob states stay within their typed domains.
properties.harm: Corrupt database records or malformed wire envelopes causing client deserialization crashes.

properties.name: SeqStrictlyMonotonic
properties.summary: The global server sequence counter never decreases, every stored record_versions row has strictly increasing seq, and every live record holds a globally unique seq <= meta.seq.
properties.harm: Pull cursors skip edits or loop indefinitely when devices catch up after being offline.

properties.name: IdempotentReplaySound
properties.summary: Replaying an already-committed batchId or changeId with an identical request body returns the stored result without advancing seq or mutating records; reusing an ID with a different body rejects change_id_reused without side effects; crash-before-commit rolls back atomically so retry applies once.
properties.harm: Duplicate highlights/notes or phantom conflicts when a flaky mobile network retries an HTTP push.

properties.name: PositionNeverConflicts
properties.summary: Per-device reading positions enforce owner-only writes, reject deletes, ignore baseVersion, fast-forward on any differing payload, and never open a conflict.
properties.harm: Spurious conflict badges on reading progress or one device clobbering another device's position.

properties.name: IdenticalContentNeverConflicts
properties.summary: Pushing content canonically identical to the head or an open side is always a noop; every open conflict contains at least two canonically distinct sides.
properties.harm: Useless '2 versions' conflict prompts when two devices independently look up the same word or delete the same highlight.

properties.name: NoSilentOverwrite
properties.summary: Every concurrent divergent write (baseVersion < head.version, distinct content) is preserved either as the head or inside conflict_sides until explicitly superseded by a valid fast-forward or ResolveConflict.
properties.harm: Silent loss of user highlights, notes, or vocabulary definitions edited offline on another device.

properties.name: BookRegisterDeterministic
properties.summary: register_book applies Rules 1 (existing sha256), 2 (attach matching format + non-empty docId), and 3 (create new book) deterministically within a transaction, never merging different formats.
properties.harm: Duplicate books with fragmented highlights after re-saving a PDF, or cross-format book corruption.

properties.name: DiskFullNeverBlocksRecords
properties.summary: When free disk falls below TailDrive's free-disk floor, book blob uploads fail with HTTP 507 disk_full while record pushes, positions, conflict resolutions, and book registrations continue unimpeded.
properties.harm: Highlights, notes, and vocabulary stop syncing just because the Mac mini's disk is near its floor for large PDF/EPUB blobs.

properties.name: SeqNeverDecreases
properties.summary: Temporal action property verifying that meta.seq is monotonically non-decreasing across every transition.
properties.harm: Cursor regression causing pull feeds to stall across restarts or transactions.

non_goals: HTTP TLS/Tailscale authentication, pairing token TTL expiry, and redeem rate limiting (§4, §5.2).
Streaming Range byte downloads and multi-chunk .part file fsync/SHA-256 hashing internals (covered by Rust BlobStore tests).
Reader macOS/Android Markdown projection, vault callout migration, and Swift/JS word-id Unicode normalization (covered by Rust wire tests and normalize.json fixture).

models.name: TailDriveSync3Way

properties.name: TypeOK
properties.summary: Local, remote, baseline, snapshots, planned actions, and conflict sibling slots stay within their valid entry and action domains.
properties.harm: Invalid planner output or malformed checkpoint state breaking macOS sync reconciliation.

properties.name: TreeWellFormed
properties.summary: Every present file or folder in both local and remote trees has a present folder parent at every step, preserved by top-down forward actions and bottom-up delete actions.
properties.harm: Orphaned file paths, failed directory creations, or files created beneath non-existent folders.

properties.name: NoSilentEditLoss
properties.summary: Every active local or remote user edit survives either at its original path, its conflict sibling copy, or under a moved kind-conflict folder subtree, including across mid-sync If-Match 409 upload races.
properties.harm: User edits silently overwritten by a concurrent remote edit or wiped out by an opposing folder/file delete.

properties.name: NoResurrectionOfCleanDelete
properties.summary: A file cleanly deleted on one side while unchanged on the other is never planned for Upload/Download and remains absent on both sides once converged.
properties.harm: Zombie files reappearing after users delete them on one device.

properties.name: NonEmptyFolderProtected
properties.summary: plan_folder_sync never plans DeleteRemote or DeleteLocal on a folder when any descendant on that side is being kept, uploaded, or downloaded (keep_remote_folders / keep_local_folders guard).
properties.harm: Deleting a folder that still holds newly added or modified files on the other side, causing data loss or repeated 409 ERR_NOT_EMPTY sync failures.

properties.name: EventualConvergence
properties.summary: Temporal liveness property proving that once bounded user edits quiesce, fair sync cycles eventually converge local, remote, and baseline to identical well-formed trees.
properties.harm: Infinite conflict-rescan loops or permanently diverged macOS and server folder trees.

non_goals: POSIX symlink traversal rejection, .DS_Store filtering, and APFS mtime/inode hash-cache invalidation.
Network transport retries, per-path SyncControl pause/block UI state, and streaming download progress callbacks.

Multi-client mid-sync races on unconditional DELETE /v1/files or new-file PUT without If-None-Match (documented as real-code findings; modeled separately under BUG_MODE = "unconditional_delete_race").

models.name: TailDriveQuotaStorage

properties.name: TypeOK
properties.summary: Files, usage counters, resumable uploads, upload RwLocks, blob storage, garbage queue, and worker states stay within valid typed domains.
properties.harm: Corrupted reservation counters or invalid SQLite upload/file metadata.

properties.name: QuotaNeverExceeded
properties.summary: Committed live file bytes (usage.used_bytes) never exceed the server quota limit under arbitrary concurrent direct puts, resumable uploads, overwrites, and deletes.
properties.harm: Concurrent overwrite-vs-delete races bypassing admission control and overfilling the user's storage quota.

properties.name: UsageMatchesLiveFiles
properties.summary: The cached usage.used_bytes table maintained by SQLite triggers always equals the exact sum of live files.size_bytes.
properties.harm: Permanent quota drift causing false 507 ERR_QUOTA_EXCEEDED errors or unbounded usage under-reporting.

properties.name: DiskFloorRespected
properties.summary: Actual free disk space (accounting for both stored blobs and staged spool files) never drops below config.free_floor_bytes.
properties.harm: Concurrent uploads exhausting the Mac mini's disk and destabilizing macOS or corrupting SQLite WAL files.

properties.name: NoDanglingLiveBlob
properties.summary: Every live file and every recorded resumable upload part points to a present blob of exact matching size in storage that is not in garbage; open_file never reads a deleted or retired blob.
properties.harm: 404/500 download failures or corrupted resumable upload reassembly when GC races with open_file or complete.

properties.name: NoOrphanedBlob
properties.summary: Every blob occupying storage is accounted for by a live file, a live upload part, an active publish/BlobRollback guard, or the SQLite garbage queue.
properties.harm: Silent disk leaks from failed commits, aborted uploads, or rolled-back If-Match conflicts.

properties.name: GarbageEventuallyReclaimed
properties.summary: Temporal liveness property proving that under weak fairness of CollectGarbage and BlobRollback, every retired or rolled-back blob in garbage is eventually deleted from storage and forgotten from SQLite.
properties.harm: Retired blobs accumulating forever and starving free disk space below the floor.

non_goals: External non-TailDrive processes consuming host disk space concurrently.
S3 eventual consistency or network partition during StorageBackend::publish.
Share token expiry wall-clock precision and HTTP Range header parsing.
